Role Purpose The ICT Project Manager will be accountable for the successful delivery of technology and infrastructure projects from initiation through closure. Working closely with technical teams, UN entities, field missions, vendors, and senior stakeholders, the role will ensure projects remain aligned with organizational objectives and that technical, operational, stakeholder, risk, and governance requirements are effectively managed throughout the project lifecycle. This ICT Project Manager role has a strong international and technical scope, requiring regular coordination with the UN technical teams across different regions and time zones, as well as direct engagement with users and stakeholders located globally. Functions / Key Results Expected The personnel will be supervised by UNOPS's Senior Programme Manager and will be responsible for the following duties: Summary of Key Functions: ICT Project Management and Delivery Technology Delivery and Implementation Stakeholder Engagement and Communications Project Documentation and Knowledge Management ICT Project Management and Delivery Coordinate ICT infrastructure and technology projects, supporting all project phases from initiation and planning to implementation, transition, and closure, while monitoring scope, timelines, risks, resources, and deliverables. Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, issues and resource requirements, ensuring they remain current throughout the project lifecycle. Ensure that all team members and stakeholders understand their respective roles, responsibilities, priorities and deadlines. Monitor project progress and performance, identify deviations and emerging risks at an early stage, and escalate issues, risks, and decisions requiring management attention. Undertake project governance activities, including project boards, working groups, technical reviews and progress reporting. Manage project deliverables and performance, including monitoring costs, resource utilization, timelines, and adherence to approved project objectives and requirements. Technology Delivery and Implementation Lead the delivery of projects involving enterprise infrastructure, data centers, cloud and hybrid environments, virtualization, systems migration, and technology modernization. Translate business and operational requirements into actionable technical deliverables and implementation activities, adapting solutions to local operational and environmental conditions where required. Coordinate technology assessments, migration planning, implementation readiness, deployment, transition, and handover activities with technical teams in UNHQ and UNGSC . Coordinate across infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, architecture, applications, operations, and mission teams to align scope, sequencing, dependencies, priorities, and implementation activities. Assess emerging technologies, ICT platforms, and solution options, and advise on their potential application and suitability within project environments. Ensure that technical documentation, architecture designs, implementation plans, testing, transition, and operational readiness activities are completed in accordance with approved project requirements and timelines. Stakeholder Engagement and Communications Perform stakeholder engagement and communication across geographically dispersed teams and regions, including meetings, technical discussions, workshops, and briefings, ensuring clear understanding of project objectives, plans, responsibilities, decisions, and required actions among technical and non-technical stakeholders. Facilitate coordination between UN HQ, offices away from HQ, and field missions, ensuring that business and operational requirements, priorities, dependencies, and user impacts are understood and addressed throughout the project lifecycle. Maintain effective stakeholder engagement throughout the project lifecycle, proactively addressing questions, concerns, emerging issues, and changes, and ensuring that relevant stakeholders are informed of project risks, decisions, and required actions. Project Documentation and Knowledge Management Develop, maintain, and organize project documentation throughout the project lifecycle, including initiation and planning documents, schedules, risk and issue registers, status reports, and closure documentation. review_candidates.title: Hoofduitvoerder Middenspanning
review_candidates.description: Organisatie- en afdelingsomschrijving Werk mee aan de energie-infrastructuur van de toekomst als Engineer Energie. Je komt terecht bij een gevestigde technische organisatie die een belangrijke rol speelt in de uitbreiding en vernieuwing van het Nederlandse elektriciteitsnet. Vanuit verschillende disciplines werken technische specialisten hier samen aan projecten binnen de midden- en hoogspanning. De projecten lopen uiteen van aanpassingen aan bestaande installaties tot omvangrijke nieuwbouw- en uitbreidingsprojecten voor grote partijen binnen de Nederlandse energievoorziening. Geen standaardwerk dus, maar projecten waarin techniek, veiligheid en een goede voorbereiding echt samenkomen. Als Hoofduitvoerder krijg je veel vertrouwen en verantwoordelijkheid. Je werkt met ervaren vakmensen, hebt korte lijnen met de voorbereiding en projectleiding en krijgt de ruimte om zelf beslissingen te nemen in de uitvoering. Ook voor de langere termijn is dit een interessante werkgever. Door de hoeveelheid projecten en technische disciplines zijn er volop mogelijkheden om door te groeien, opleidingen te volgen of jezelf verder te specialiseren binnen de energietechniek. Zoek je een stabiele werkgever, uitdagende projecten én een omgeving waarin jouw ervaring als uitvoerder echt wordt gewaardeerd? Dan is dit zeker een organisatie om eens mee kennis te maken. Ben jij klaar om je loopbaan in de energietransitie écht vaart te geven? Neem contact op met Michel Dirks via 06-3003 5990 of mail naar m.dirks@multiselect.nl — dan bespreken we samen hoe jij kunt doorgroeien in de sector van de toekomst! Functie-informatie Als Hoofduitvoerder ben jij degene die ervoor zorgt dat het buiten goed geregeld is. Je bent betrokken vanaf de voorbereiding en denkt vroegtijdig mee over de aanpak en uitvoerbaarheid van een project. Zodra het project in uitvoering gaat, houd jij de regie. Je stuurt monteurs en uitvoerende collega's aan, bewaakt de voortgang en hebt regelmatig overleg met de werkvoorbereider en projectleider. Je werkt aan elektrotechnische installaties binnen de midden- en hoogspanning. Hierbij kun je denken aan kabelverbindingen, transformatoren, schakelinstallaties en de bijbehorende beveiligings- en besturingssystemen. Jouw Werkzaamheden Zijn Onder Andere Coördineren van de dagelijkse werkzaamheden op projectlocaties; Aansturen en begeleiden van monteurs en andere uitvoerende partijen; Vooraf beoordelen van werkzaamheden en projectlocaties; Organiseren van de benodigde mensen, materialen en middelen; Bewaken van planning, budget, kwaliteit en voortgang; Signaleren en oplossen van knelpunten tijdens de uitvoering; Controleren of werkzaamheden volgens de geldende veiligheidsregels worden uitgevoerd; Afstemmen met werkvoorbereiding, projectleiding en opdrachtgever; Bijhouden van de projectadministratie en zorgen voor een goede afronding en overdracht. Je krijgt daarbij veel eigen verantwoordelijkheid. Loopt iets anders dan gepland? Dan wacht je niet af, maar zoek je samen met het team naar een praktische oplossing. Aanbod Salaris tussen €4.500 en €6.500 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring en opleiding. Uitdagende projecten op het gebied van duurzame energieverbindingen. Werken bij een vooraanstaande organisatie met volop groeimogelijkheden. Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder een telefoon en auto van de zaak. 25 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen. Functie-eisen Voor deze functie zoeken we iemand die de wereld van middenspanning kent en zich prettig voelt in een verantwoordelijke rol buiten op het project. Je Beschikt Bij Voorkeur Over Een mbo 4-opleiding Elektrotechniek, Energietechniek of vergelijkbaar; Ervaring met midden- en/of hoogspanningsinstallaties; Ervaring als Uitvoerder, Hoofduitvoerder of in een vergelijkbare functie; Relevante elektrotechnische certificeringen; Ervaring met het begeleiden en aansturen van technische medewerkers. Daarnaast ben je duidelijk in je communicatie, praktisch ingesteld en blijf je rustig wanneer er tijdens de uitvoering onverwachte situaties ontstaan. Veilig werken is voor jou vanzelfsprekend. Solliciteren bij Michel Dirks is jouw contactpersoon bij Multiselect en staat klaar om je verder te helpen in jouw carrière als Hoofduitvoerder Middenspanning in de regio Rotterdam. Met jarenlange ervaring in personeelsbemiddeling begrijpt Michel jouw ambities en weet hij de juiste match te maken. Neem contact op met Michel via 06-3003 5990 of stuur je cv naar m.dirks@multiselect.nl. Solliciteer

review_candidates.description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main Platforms ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About The Role We are looking for a Global Technical Talent Lead to own hiring across Engineering, Product, Design, Research, and Growth worldwide. Reporting to the Head of Talent, you will lead Talent leaders and partner with senior engineering, growth, and research leaders to build the teams powering ElevenLabs. Your mandate is to bring cohesion to hiring strategy, execution, and standards across this portfolio, with accountability for hiring quality, pace, and predictability. Turn engineering priorities into a deliverable global hiring plan. Partner with functional leaders to translate product roadmaps, research priorities, and workforce plans into hiring plans. Own Talent capacity allocation, planning, forecasting, and reporting. Build and lead a cohesive global recruiting organization. Coach and develop Talent leaders, establish clear accountability for results, and allocate resources across disciplines and markets as priorities change. Build shared practices for talent mapping, sourcing, candidate experience, and closing while developing the specialist expertise each talent market requires. Define and uphold the hiring bar across technical disciplines. Partner with functional leaders to define excellence by role and level, translating it into clear success profiles, rigorous assessment, and consistent hiring decisions. Equip the team to engage exceptional talent, credibly represent the work, and help candidates understand the opportunity and impact. Make hiring performance visible and predictable. Establish regular hiring reviews with functional and senior leadership to track delivery, surface risks, and resolve decisions. Use market intelligence and funnel data to advise on location strategy, skill availability, and interviewer capacity. Partner with Talent Ops to improve systems, tools, processes, and the use of AI, so hiring is demonstrably faster and more efficient. Requirements You have led Talent through hypergrowth at a company that grew 3x or more in two years, owning delivery of hundreds to thousands of hires annually across multiple regions and time zones. You have a proven track record of managing teams of Talent leaders and delivering business critical hiring across engineering, research, growth, design, and product disciplines. You can earn the trust of senior engineering, growth, product, design, and research leaders, partner on hiring decisions, and advise on talent availability, location, role scope, and assessment. You have deep expertise in the varying talent markets. You have translated changing business and technical priorities into credible hiring forecasts and recruiting capacity plans. You use pipeline, conversion, hiring lead times, and interviewer capacity to distinguish achievable commitments from emerging risks and guide resource decisions. You combine strong people leadership with deep recruiting expertise. You have raised team performance through coaching, partnered with hiring leaders to improve assessments, and maintained a high hiring bar at scale. You can personally unblock a difficult search or help close an exceptional candidate. Location This role is remote and can be executed globally. Preference for candidates based in US East or GMT timezones. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
